entries.title: GCS Artifact Publish with Workload Identity Federation

entries.title: Client Auth Runtime Contract Pattern

entries.title: Artifact Manifest Contract Alignment

entries.title: Canonical App Directory Structure

entries.title: Init App Token Replacement Gaps
entries.summary: The app bootstrap script can leave template-name tokens in key files after initialization, requiring manual cleanup.

entries.title: Pull Request Template Standardization
entries.summary: Add a repository PR template so required Why/Todo Mapping/Validation/Deploy sections are present in every PR.

entries.title: Template Feedback Loop
entries.summary: Capture reusable implementation learnings in app repos and backport stable patterns into this canonical template.

entries.title: Testing Suite Rollout Pattern
entries.summary: Stage test execution into smoke, publish, regression, and prod-monitor buckets with clear workflow triggers and status reporting.
